summary.name: MentionDesk
summary.one_liner: MentionDesk is a paid Answer Engine Optimization tool that tracks and helps improve how often a brand is mentioned in responses from AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini.
keywords: how to get brand mentioned by ai
use_cases: Track how a brand appears in AI answers across major chatbots
Monitor ranking position and mentions for key prompts
Compare brand visibility against competitors in AI responses
Identify which sources drive AI mentions for a brand and its rivals
Get a weekly ranked list of content fixes to improve AI visibility
summary.what_it_does: MentionDesk tracks a brand's visibility across eight AI platforms (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, Google AI Mode, Claude, DeepSeek, Mistral) with daily-updated dashboards. Users manage a set of tracked prompts and see visibility scores, total and unique mentions, and average position per prompt, plus full archives of the AI responses and historic trends. It includes competitor benchmarking on visibility, mentions and position, and source mapping showing which sites contribute to brand and competitor mentions. An Action Center produces a weekly ranked plan of opportunities with supporting evidence and checklists, and checks automatically whether gaps have closed.
notable: Tracks eight AI platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek and Mistral
Source intelligence maps which sites drive AI mentions for a brand versus competitors
Weekly Action Center with ranked, evidence-backed recommendations and automatic win verification
caveats: Paid plans after a 3-day free trial, priced from $79/month (Lite) up to $549/month (Advanced)
Custom pricing for larger tracked-prompt volumes is available by contacting the vendor
Tracking is prompt-based, so results reflect the prompts chosen by the user
